name: 4-FEA
summary: Stimulant that is the ethyl analogue of 4-FMA.
doseBasis: Note: Tentative data as of writing.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the substituted amphetamines, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, jaw clenching, loss of appetite, insomnia, anxiety and a low mood afterwards. Serious risks include heart problems, stroke, psychosis and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的取代安非他命類藥物，可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、咬緊牙關、食慾不振、失眠、焦慮，以及藥效過後的情緒低落。嚴重風險包括心臟問題、中風、精神病與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的取代安非他命类药物，可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、咬紧牙关、食欲不振、失眠、焦虑，以及药效过后的情绪低落。严重风险包括心脏问题、中风、精神病与成瘾。

fact.en: Its name spells out its structure: 4-fluoro means a fluorine atom on the fourth position of the benzene ring, and ethylamphetamine means an ethyl group sits on the nitrogen. It is the ethyl cousin of 4-FMA.
fact.zh: 它的名字就說明了結構：「4-fluoro」表示苯環第四個位置上有一個氟原子，「ethylamphetamine」表示氮原子上接了一個乙基。它是4-FMA的乙基版本。
fact.zhHans: 它的名字就说明了结构：「4-fluoro」表示苯环第四个位置上有一个氟原子，「ethylamphetamine」表示氮原子上接了一个乙基。它是4-FMA的乙基版本。
